'''Verde's Belt''', also known as the '''Verde asteroid field''', was an expansive asteroid field in the Verde system. The mineral rich [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] that formed it made it a hotbed for illegal mining. It contained the planetoid [[Yen-2]].
